description: FAIRiCUBE publishes a Luxembourg City land-use raster as one public four-band 10-metre GeoTIFF under CC BY 4.0. The provider defines land use as the socio-economic purpose of an area, distinct from its physical land cover. The filename suggests four vintages, but the landing page does not explain band order, dates, class codes or mapping methods. Land-use scenarios can help place residential, employment or green-space assumptions in a city infrastructure-demand or stormwater model. This file is a contextual classification, not a census, building inventory or legal planning register. Interpretation of the four bands and any temporal change must be checked before quantitative analysis. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Luxembourg City resource. The raster was not downloaded; actual band metadata, projection, class legend and completeness remain unverified.
